body:
My brother suggested a long walk to the local woods which was well enjoyed. We had not taken any sleepy grass at this point, we had a thorough conversation about various psychedelics.
After searching for the long grass from around 20- 30 minutes to find the well known sleepy grass, we sat down and cleared a nice path to sit down on, from our left to our right we took a good handful of sleepy grass. We had researched many sources and thought between 60 - 80 was a good dosage to start the trip, we methodically counted out 80 each to the dot and consumed happily.
T = 15 minutes; (fifteen minutes in) nothing much at the moment but have strong sense of overwhelming power.
T = 30 minutes; (thirty minutes in) my brother turned to me and said 'this is some hum dinger grass mate' and straight away his face fractualed up into a million pieces, EXISTENCE WAS GONE!!
I blacked out for around 10-15 minutes. About 45min gone now I realised what life was all about.....Grass. Without mother natures source of compost and grass we would not be here everything made sense good sense of wellbeing and was calm.
My brother= I had come to at this point and he recalled his trip which goes like this. After he said 'this is some hum dinger grass' he left his body went straight to the darkest corner off the earth. I then assured him that its only grass by then he'd fogotten.
April 25 2009 T = 23:45 It was late now, too late to redose but we are definetly doing it tomoro morning at 8:35.
